name: MM-VET-Bench-pt
description: A Portuguese multimodal evaluation benchmark designed to test models on tasks combining visual input and Portuguese veterinary (or related) text. It measures multimodal understanding and reasoning over paired image-text items and supports classification and generative/open-ended evaluations. Intended for assessing Portuguese-capable multimodal models in a domain-specific setting.
reputation: A smaller, domain-specific dataset with limited adoption so far, primarily used by researchers focusing on Portuguese multimodal evaluation.
